user.title: Connect to Controme
user.description: Connect to the Controme Mini-Server in your local network. The JSON API uses plain HTTP: the password is transmitted unencrypted, so use this only in your local network.

data_description.host: Address of the Mini-Server, e.g. 192.0.2.10 or controme.local.
data_description.username: Controme user; needed for the room details and for writing.

reauth_confirm.title: Controme credentials rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The Mini-Server at {host} rejected the credentials. Enter them again.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Mini-Server. Check the address and that it is in the same network.
error.api_disabled: The API is disabled on this Controme system. Enable it in Controme and try again.
error.no_house: No house with rooms was found on this Controme system.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Controme system is already configured.
